[[Team Galactic HQ]] }} '''Encountering Elekid''' (Japanese: '''VS エレキッド''' ''VS Elekid''), titled '''VS Elekid''' in the [[Chuang Yi]] translation, is the 404th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 67th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Diamond & Pearl}}. It is subtitled '''Enemy Headquarter and Intruder''' (Japanese: '''敵陣と侵入者''' ''Enemy Lines and Intruders'') in the [[VIZ Media]] translation and '''Enemy Line and Intruders''' in the Chuang Yi translation. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} After passing out at the [[Snowpoint Temple]], {{adv|Platinum}} wakes up at the [[Snowpoint City]] [[Pokémon Center]] to find [[Maylene]] and [[Candice]] staring over her. The two [[Gym Leader]]s thank her for carrying them there, but Platinum is confused as she only remembers bringing them to the temple. She apologizes to Candice for entering it without permission, but Candice reveals that even she does not know what is inside. Maylene tries to rally the others to come up with a new way to defeat [[Team Galactic]], but they are interrupted when the phone rings for Candice. [[Byron]] is on the line—returning a call from her—and she demands for backup while Maylene requests for someone to train them. Byron promises to send someone over, then hangs up. Unable to go himself, as he is still caring for [[Professor Rowan]] and [[Mr. Berlitz]], he considers sending [[Roark]]. When Byron remembers that Roark's strength may not be enough, he realizes that there is someone much stronger who can help. He is hesitant to reach out, but attempts to call them. To his surprise, the line drops due to a blackout. At [[Sunyshore City]], the [[Valley Windworks]] manager and his daughter investigate the cause of the blackout. The manager determines that it was caused when the entire city's electricity was diverted to one particular place—the [[Sunyshore Gym]]. When the two enter, they are met with bright light shining from inside. The Gym Leader, [[Volkner]], mistakes them for challengers, and becomes disappointed when he learns that they are only there to learn why the power has gone out. As the two walk farther into the [[Gym]], they see a massive network of gears using up all of the electricity. Volkner explains that because he has been so bored due to a lack of strong challengers, he has spent his time renovating the Gym to entertain himself. As the manager berates Volkner for hogging all of the electricity, he is interrupted by the sound of Volkner's phone ringing. After picking up the call, Volkner gets to his feet and begins to leave, saying that he suspects "something exciting" will soon take place. At the [[Team Galactic HQ]], [[Cyrus]] and the [[Advanced level Grunt]] prepare to extract power from the {{adv|lake guardians}} to create a material for the [[Red Chain]]. Cyrus begins the extraction, and a crystal forms from the lake guardians' power. Cyrus reveals to the Advanced level Grunt that he will be creating two chains—one for {{DL|Pokémon of myth (Adventures)|Dialga}}, and one for {{DL|Pokémon of myth (Adventures)|Palkia}}. He explains that when the chains intertwine, their powers of time and space will allow for the creation of a new universe that will absorb their current world. Cyrus and the Advanced level Grunt decide to wait for the lake guardians to recharge their power so it may be extracted once more. As Cyrus walks by the hangar in the HQ, a figure can be seen underneath one of the airships. Hiding in the shadows with {{adv|Lax}} and [[Don]], {{adv|Diamond}} makes a promise to save the lake guardians. ==Major events== * {{adv|Platinum}} wakes up at the [[Pokémon Center]] in [[Snowpoint City]]. * [[Candice]] tells [[Byron]] they need some training. * Byron calls [[Volkner]] to help train Platinum, [[Maylene]], and Candice. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== * [[Volkner]] ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Diamond}} * {{adv|Platinum}} * [[Professor Rowan]] * [[Roark]] (fantasy) * [[Maylene]] * [[Byron]] * [[Candice]] * [[Volkner]] * [[Cyrus]] * [[Charon]] * [[Advanced level Grunt]] * [[Mr. Berlitz]] * [[Pokémon Center lady]] * [[Valley Windworks]] manager * Valley Windworks manager's daughter ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Munchlax}} ({{adv|Lax}}; {{adv|Diamond}}'s) * {{p|Shieldon}} ([[Don]]; {{adv|Diamond}}'s) * {{p|Rapidash}} ({{OP|Platinum|Rapidash}}) * {{p|Empoleon}} ({{OP|Platinum|Empoleon}}) * {{p|Lopunny}} ({{OP|Platinum|Lopunny}}) * {{p|Rampardos}} ({{OP|Roark|Rampardos}}; fantasy) * {{p|Onix}} ([[Roark]]'s; fantasy) * {{p|Riolu}} ([[Maylene]]'s) * {{p|Bronzong}} ([[Byron]]'s; ×2) * {{p|Froslass}} ({{OP|Candice|Froslass}}) * {{p|Raichu}} ([[Volkner]]'s) * {{p|Elekid}} ([[Volkner]]'s) * {{p|Honchkrow}} ([[Cyrus]]'s) * {{p|Drifloon}} ([[Valley Windworks]] manager's) * {{p|Uxie}} ({{DL|Lake guardians (Adventures)|Uxie|Adventures}}) * {{p|Mesprit}} ({{DL|Lake guardians (Adventures)|Mesprit|Adventures}}) * {{p|Azelf}} ({{DL|Lake guardians (Adventures)|Azelf|Adventures}}) * {{p|Dialga}} ({{DL|Pokémon of myth (Adventures)|Dialga|Adventures}}; fantasy) * {{p|Palkia}} ({{DL|Pokémon of myth (Adventures)|Palkia|Adventures}}; fantasy) * {{p|Voltorb}} ==Trivia== ===Errors=== ==In other languages== {{Epilang|color=FFCCCC|bordercolor=9999FF |zh_cmn={{tt|VS 電擊怪|VS Elekid}} (Taiwan)
